title: Blank Payloads Outside the Input
statement: For every binary word $x$ and integer $z$ satisfying $z<-1$ or $|x|<z$, the virtual input payload at $z$ is the blank payload.
hypotheses_covered: Integer coordinate z satisfies z < -1 or |x| < z
replaced:
For every binary word $x$ and every integer coordinate $z$ with $z < -1$ or
$z > |x|$, the virtual input payload of $x$ at $z$ is the blank payload; outside both
virtual boundaries the head-centered input tape is blank.
